Question 8

A particle moves along a circular path centered at O in the xy-plane in the counterclockwise direction with a constant angular velocity of 2 rad/s. Given that the object is at the position (5,0) when t=0, find the position function of the particle.

a
 r(t)=5(cos⁡2ti−sin⁡2tj)
b
 r(t)=2(cos⁡5ti+sin⁡5tj)
c
 r(t)=2(cos⁡5ti−sin⁡5tj)
d
 r(t)=5(sin⁡2ti+cos⁡2tj)
e
 r(t)=5(cos⁡2ti+sin⁡2tj)
